title: Colimit of a category-valued diagram by inversion of Cartesian transport
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories, coherent functor categories, equivalences and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], Cartesian fibrations and Cartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and the classifying equivalence supplied by the opposite of [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening]. Fix a universe $\mathcal U$ in which all indexing categories and total categories below are small, and a containing universe for $\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal U}$, the infinity category of $\mathcal U$-small quasicategories. Its small colimits and internal functor categories are those of [lem-coef-infinity-functor-pushout]. Let $B$ be a small quasicategory, $F:B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal U}$ a coherent functor, and $p:E\to B$ a Cartesian fibration classified by $F$. Set $C_F=\operatorname{colim}_{B^{\mathrm{op}}}F$. There is a canonical functor $\ell_p:E\to C_F$ whose restriction to each fiber is the corresponding leg of the colimit cocone. For every infinity category $T$ in a sufficiently large universe, restriction gives an equivalence
$$\ell_p^*:\operatorname{Fun}(C_F,T)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{Cart}(p)}(E,T),$$
where the right side is the full subcategory of functors carrying every $p$-Cartesian edge to an equivalence; the assertion includes all mapping spaces and noninvertible natural transformations. For every functor $u:A\to B$ between small quasicategories, put $p_u:E_u=A\times_BE\to A$, with projection $r:E_u\to E$. Under classification $p_u$ corresponds to $F\circ u^{\mathrm{op}}$. The canonical colimit comparison $c_u:C_{F\circ u^{\mathrm{op}}}\to C_F$ satisfies the natural equivalence
$$c_u\ell_{p_u}\simeq\ell_p r.$$
No colimits in the fibers of $p$ are assumed.

proof.text:
The pullback of $T\to *$ along $B\to *$ is the Cartesian fibration $B\times T\to B$; since the Cartesian edges of $T\to\Delta^0$ are exactly the equivalences (step 1, from [lem-coef-marked-anodyne-lifting-calculus] and the lifting criterion over $\Delta^0$), its natural marking is $B^{\sharp}\times T^{\natural}$ by the pullback-marking clause. Dual straightening identifies it with the constant diagram $\Delta T$ on $B^{\mathrm{op}}$: straightening over a point has value its fiber $T$, and base change is precomposition. A map $E\to B\times T$ over $B$ has the form $(p,h)$, and is marking-preserving exactly when $h$ inverts every $p$-Cartesian edge. This is an identity on the entire sharp mapping complexes, including all parameter simplices. Both relative objects are fibrant and cofibrant. The relative marked model and the model-localization mapping-space comparison therefore identify this complex with their mapping space in the infinity category of Cartesian fibrations over $B$. Apply the dual straightening equivalence on that mapping space to obtain, naturally in $T$,
$$H_p(T)^{\simeq}\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{Cat}_\infty)}(F,\Delta T).$$
Only Cartesian-edge-preserving maps, which are the morphisms in the stated straightening equivalence, were used; no assertion about arbitrary maps out of a Grothendieck construction is needed.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 3.3.4.2, straightening and the constant-diagram adjunction; mapping spaces spelled out instead of only the homotopy-category comparison

proof.text:
Apply the preceding straightening comparison to the marked map $(p,q_p):E\to B\times L_p$. It gives a coherent cocone $\lambda_p:F\to\Delta L_p$, whose leg at $b$ is $q_p|_{E_b}$ under $E_b\simeq F(b)$. For $f:L_p\to T$, functoriality of straightening takes $(p,fq_p)$ to $(\Delta f)\lambda_p$. Thus the composite of the equivalences in steps 1 and 2 is precisely the map
$$\operatorname{Map}(L_p,T)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{Cat}_\infty)}(F,\Delta T),\qquad f\longmapsto(\Delta f)\lambda_p.$$
It is an equivalence for every $T$. The cocone mapping-space criterion now says that $(L_p,\lambda_p)$ is a colimiting cocone. Compare it with the stated colimit $(C_F,\iota_F)$: the contractible category of initial cocones gives an equivalence $k_p:L_p\simeq C_F$ together with $k_p\lambda_p\simeq\iota_F$, unique with these coherent data up to contractible choice. Define $\ell_p=k_pq_p$. Its fiber restrictions are therefore the specified colimit legs, with their full coherent cocone, rather than separately chosen pointwise identifications.

source.place: Corollary 3.3.4.3 and proof of Proposition 3.3.4.2; direct universal-cocone argument expanding the straightening/constant-diagram adjunction
Corollary 3.3.4.3 interpreted as localization; full-functor strengthening via the marked cartesian product assertion (Proposition 3.1.4.2), explicitly proved here

proof.text:
Let $u:A\to B$ and $r:E_u\to E$ be as in the statement. The pullback-marking clause makes $r:E_u^{\mathrm{Cart}}\to E^{\mathrm{Cart}}$ a marked map, and dual straightening classifies $E_u$ by $F\circ u^{\mathrm{op}}$. Functorial absolute fibrant replacement gives $h=L(r):L_{p_u}\to L_p$ satisfying $h q_{p_u}=q_p r$. Pulling back the map $(p,q_p):E\to B\times L_p$ along $u$ gives exactly $(p_u,q_pr):E_u\to A\times L_p$. The coherent base-change naturality of straightening therefore identifies its cocone with $\lambda_p\circ u^{\mathrm{op}}$. On the other hand the same map equals $(p_u,hq_{p_u})$, so functoriality of straightening identifies its cocone with $(\Delta h)\lambda_{p_u}$. This explicitly proves $h\lambda_{p_u}\simeq\lambda_pu^{\mathrm{op}}$ on the coherent diagram, including its higher simplices. The two maps $c_uk_{p_u}$ and $k_ph$ from $L_{p_u}$ to $C_F$ consequently induce the same restricted cocone $\iota_Fu^{\mathrm{op}}$. The colimiting mapping-space equivalence from step 3 has contractible homotopy fibers, and hence gives a coherent equivalence $c_uk_{p_u}\simeq k_ph$ compatible with those cocones. Precompose with $q_{p_u}$ and use its displayed naturality equality to obtain
$$c_u\ell_{p_u}\simeq k_phq_{p_u}=k_pq_pr=\ell_pr.$$
Functorial replacement and base change commute with compositions and identities before passage to cocones; the contractible comparison fibers retain those compatibilities. This is the asserted natural equivalence. The only colimits used were in $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$ and the marked model, never inside a fiber.
